body.statement: Using \(\mathfrak H_{\mathrm{loc}}\), determine the sharp cardinality-uniform order of \(R_T(t_0,\zeta,1+\delta_T)\) for every deterministic sequence \(\delta_T\downarrow0\), construct an observable estimator attaining that order, and prove the matching all-measurable lower bound. In particular, characterize the exact threshold sequence separating the parametric immediate-weighting regime from the logarithmic-history regime, without imposing proxy informativeness, emission rank, finite memory, or known latent dynamics.
body.justification: The fixed-radius theorem and equality boundary force a local phase transition whose location is not determined by either endpoint.
body.gap: HuWager2023 localizes risk only by mixing and action overlap, and MehrabiWager2025 varies observable density-ratio tails rather than an unobserved stationary-law radius approaching equality.
body.consumer: The threshold would quantify how strong an approximate physiological-occupancy assurance must be before it changes data-collection duration or estimator choice.
